verdict.rationale: The product documents two install routes. The `npx skills add` installer writes editable skill files into your project, and a runtime probe confirmed a selective install to ./.claude/skills/. The alternative is a managed plugin install via the Claude Code, Codex or Copilot marketplaces, a read-only, self-updating bundle. The evidence frames that choice as 'fork vs subscribe', not as project vs user-global scope; nothing documents that the plugin route or any installer flag installs user-globally across all projects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a user-global install scope option, evidence that skills are shared across all projects, and guidance on committing project-local files to the repo.
